presets.label: CRT
presets.name: CRT Guest Advanced
presets.description: Detailed CRT simulation with phosphor afterglow, bloom, halation and masks. The most demanding of the two; its first compile takes a few seconds.

presets.label: Fast CRT
presets.name: zfast CRT
presets.description: Lighter CRT scanlines with a fine mask. A good choice when the detailed shader costs too much frame time.
